name: partial_completion_one_eligible_line_and_one
branch: The customer asks to return two items from a delivered order, where one item is eligible for return and the other is final sale
tests: the agent evaluates Marcus Vance's order O472, creates a return authorization for the eligible T-shirt (AP01) after confirmation, and refuses a return for the Final Sale Graphic Hoodie (FS02) while explaining the final-sale policy
instruction:
You received order O472 6 days ago containing an Organic Cotton Crewneck T-Shirt (AP01) and a Final Sale Graphic Hoodie (FS02). You want to return both items because you changed your mind. If the agent explains that the Graphic Hoodie is final sale and cannot be returned, accept returning only the T-shirt (AP01) and confirm when asked.

Your details:
- Name: Marcus Vance
- Email: marcus.vance@example.com
- Postal Code: 30301
- Order ID: O472

persona.name: Marcus Vance
persona.initial_message: Hi, I'd like to return both items from my order O472: the Organic Cotton Crewneck T-Shirt and the Graphic Hoodie. Postal code is 30301.

fixed.items: the items and quantities the customer settled on
